name: Blueberry Town: A Date with a Gentleman
detailed_description:
◆ Story


I really enjoy the leisure of being single... although I say that, every time I think about my friends and their sweet moments with their partners, I feel a bit hesitant. The catchy dating show advertisements keep playing over and over in my head — "Blueberry Chewbit, Blueberry Chewbit, Blueberry Chewbit," and "This is a show that helps you find a partner for free..." It's so annoying! I’m not joining that! I’ll just buy a few bottles of alcohol to drink and forget all about it—who would have thought that the next morning, I’d wake up to a successful registration notice for Blueberry Chewbit!? Drinking really does mess things up!

I figured I wouldn’t make it to the end anyway, so I forced myself to join, stepping into a world I’d never seen before—

The cheerful and talkative macaw chatted with me about the fun moments of traveling, and when I struggled to keep the conversation going, he cleverly shifted to new topics. His sunny, radiant personality almost made me forget his dull feathers...

The rebellious white cat, whose every move was that of a seasoned heartthrob, bold and direct, completely unlike me. Why would a beastman like him come to a dating show?



The shy and introverted guinea pig, speaking so quietly and trembling, like a phone on silent mode, but when it came to food, he couldn’t stop talking, his face glowing with a satisfied smile.

The silent and reserved black wolf, tall and elegant, exuding an overwhelming presence, yet his eyes kept drifting away, as if he couldn’t look me in the eye. Wait, could it be...!?

What hidden stories do these guests carry? Can someone as "ordinary" as me unravel their emotional knots while also healing myself? After the show ends, will I be able to become friends with them—or even develop a deeper relationship?

◆ Gameplay


"Players control the protagonist, Bane, as he interacts with the guests of 'Blueberry Chewbit,' observes each person's state and preferences, and makes corresponding choices to pursue the one he likes!"

◆ Game Features


◇ 12 basic CGs, including over 36 variations
◇ 100,000 words of game text
◇ One male protagonist, four male characters to pursue
◇ Number of game endings: 6

short_description: By chance, I joined a dating show called Blueberry Chewbit, where I met the talkative and gentle Kama, the carefree Kailar, the shy and introverted Tessel, and the still silent Ubis, who hasn’t changed since I last saw him. Each person exudes a strong personality, with hidden stories behind them...
